name: Mining
summary: Break rocks for ore, smelt it into bars or sell it.

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.body: Buy a [[pickaxe]] from the [[weapons-shop]] in the second village.

sections.heading: Ores
sections.body:
Each rock shows its ore and a health bar, and yields exactly one ore.

- [[silver]]: 120 health, 6 XP
- [[ruby]]: 125 health, 9 XP
- [[coal]]: 50 health, 3 XP; fuel for smelting

sections.heading: Smelting
sections.body: At the [[blacksmiths-forge]]: [[silver-bar]] (1 Silver + 4 Coal) and [[ruby-bar]] (1 Ruby + 10 Coal).

sections.heading: Selling
sections.body: The [[ore-buyer]] in each village buys ore in lots of 60.
